title.description: Checklist heading, e.g. 'Specification Quality Checklist: Carts Service Foundation (E1)' or 'Consistency Check — Layer 2'.

purpose.description: What this checklist validates, e.g. 'Validate specification completeness and quality before implementation'.

scope.description: Free-text scope note: single feature (per-spec) vs cross-spec/singleton, and what it does not cover.

feature.description: Generic free-text reference to the feature/spec this checklist covers (link or name); omitted for cross-spec checklists.

canonical_sources.description: Ordered tie-breaker sources cited by cross-spec checklists when artifacts disagree (e.g. constitution, decision log). Opaque strings.

name.description: Free-text section heading, e.g. 'Content Quality', 'Requirement Completeness', 'Constitution Compliance'. Not enumerated — varies per checklist purpose.

id.description: Sequential item id (e.g. CHK001 or CHK-001). Optional — many real checklists use plain checkbox bullets with no explicit id.

notes.description: Free-text evidence/finding/gap noted inline or in a trailing Notes section for this item.
Trailing free-text notes not tied to a single item (e.g. a checklist's closing '## Notes' section).
